statement: An empty question MUST be treated as matching a recorded `## Context` of `(none recorded)`, and ONLY that. `(none recorded)` is what an emitter writes when the question was genuinely unrecorded, so the two spellings of 'no question' have to agree -- otherwise a re-capture forks a twin record.
note: Verified by execution: the legacy file whose Context body is `(none recorded)` is reused. A legacy file recording a REAL question is NOT claimed by an empty question -- see the invalid pair.
